_comment: Copy to e.g. config/upload_cases/<target-name>.json and list the upload endpoints to probe. Set response_url_json_path if the upload response returns the file's URL in JSON (dotted path, e.g. 'data.url'), or uploaded_file_url_template if the app's upload URLs follow a predictable pattern ('{filename}' gets substituted). Without either, this only reports whether the upload was accepted, not whether it executed.
